children: Shares of ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Ltd. are in focus on Tuesday, October 13, after it reported its second quarter earnings post-market hours a day prior.

It reported a healthy operational quarter, which was broadly in-line with estimates. However, its assets under management (AUM) growth being below the industry, higher redemptions and market share loss were the key negatives.
However, brokerages HSBC and Bernstein were positive on the stock and saw up to 19% upside from current levels.
ICICI Prudential AMC's revenue increased 7% sequentially to ₹1,674 crore from ₹1,564.22 crore. This was marginally below Bloomberg's estimate of ₹1,689 crore and was aided by better revenue yield.
Its earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBTIDA) increased 7% to ₹1,215 crore from ₹1,132.62 crore, which was marginally above Bloomberg's estimate of ₹1,206 crore.

ICICI Prudential AMC's profit after tax (PAT) declined 8% to ₹889 crore from the previous quarter's ₹964.6 crore, which was in-line with estimates of ₹892 crore. This came on the back of other income declining 91% sequentially to ₹17 crore from ₹181 crore due to higher month-to-month gains in the first quarter.

The mutual fund quarterly average assets under management (QAAUM) increased 3.9% to ₹11.61 lakh crore from the previous quarter's ₹11.17 lakh crore, compared to industry growth of 5.1%. Its market share declined by 10 basis points to 13.3%.
Meanwhile, its equity QAAUM increased 4.4% sequentially to ₹6.59 lakh from ₹6.31 lakh crore compared to industry growth of 6.6%, resulting in its market share contracting by 30 basis points to 13.7%.
Its systematic transactions were down 4.1% at ₹4,672 crore from the previous quarter's ₹4,872 crore, with higher redemptions in hybrid funds.
The company's board of directors also declared an interim dividend of ₹30 per equity shares and set October 21 as the record date for the same.
HSBC Says Buy Despite Concerns
The brokerage has a "buy" rating and a target price of ₹3,530 per share.
It said the second quarter performance was mixed, with stronger-than-expected core profits, which were offset by a loss of AUM market share.
ICICI Prudential AMC's growth remains constrained by muted industry flows in its core categories, although the alternatives are providing partial support, HSBC said.
The brokerage added that the slowdown appears to be cyclical, while its structural position remains sound.
Bernstein Remains Bullish On ICICI Prudential AMC
The brokerage has an "outperform" rating on the stock with a target price of ₹3,510 per share.

According to Bernstein, the company's second quarter mutual funds AUM growth was at 14% from the year-ago period and was up 4% on a sequential basis. Meanwhile, its management fee grew 16% from last year and 7% from the previous quarter.

It said weaker growth in other income (drawdown in equity markets) and higher tax rate meant that ICICI Prudential AMC's reported profits grew 6% from last year but declined 8% from the first quarter. However, its core operating profits grew at a healthy 16% from the year-ago period and were up 7% from the previous quarter, it added.
The company updated that the board has approved the portfolio management services (PMS) business acquisition from ICICI securities with pending approvals, Bernstein said.
Stock reaction
Of the 19 analysts who have coverage on the ICICI Prudential AMC stock, 16 have a "buy" rating, two have a "hold" rating and one has a "sell" rating.
Shares of ICICI Prudential AMC declined 2% to ₹2,969.1 apiece in the previous session. It has declined 3% in the past month but is up 12.8% in 2026, so far.
The stock is up 14.2% from its listing price of ₹2,600 and up 37% from its issue price of ₹2,165 apiece.
